title: Maybe: Markers and Mood
goal: Choose between the indicative and the subjunctive after a lo mejor, quizás, tal vez and puede que to show how sure you are.

sections.title: Unit 3: Hypothesizing and Probability
body: At B2 you do not only say what you know and what you do not know. You also show how sure you are: it is certain, likely, possible or just a guess. This unit is about that scale.

You will practise the words for 'maybe' and the mood after them, expressions such as es probable que, the future and the conditional for guesses, and adverbs such as seguramente and sin duda. The unit ends with a short text about the Colombian writer Gabriel García Márquez and his novel Crónica de una muerte anunciada.

items: I can use a lo mejor with the indicative and puede que with the subjunctive.
I can choose the indicative or the subjunctive after quizás and tal vez to show how sure I am.
I can use the new words for guessing.
